name: Two Pointers
description: Technique using two index pointers moving towards each other or simultaneously to process sorted arrays or detect intervals in linear time.
commonWeaknessPatterns: Off-by-one pointer index
Infinite loop when pointers fail to increment
Applying on unsorted data without sorting

name: Sliding Window
description: Sub-array/sub-string tracking with dynamic or fixed expansion and contraction bounds.
commonWeaknessPatterns: Shrinking window condition check off-by-one
Failing to update state map during window contraction

name: HashMap Lookups & Frequency
description: O(1) average-time dictionary lookup and occurrence counters for eliminating nested inner loops.
commonWeaknessPatterns: Using array.includes() instead of Set.has()
Key collisions / type coercion errors in keys

name: Binary Search
description: Logarithmic search on monotonic condition spaces or sorted collections.
commonWeaknessPatterns: Integer overflow on mid calculation
Infinite loop with left <= right vs left < right

name: Monotonic Stack
description: Stack maintaining elements in strictly ascending or descending order for Next Greater Element problems.
commonWeaknessPatterns: Pushing values instead of indices
Inverted comparison condition in while loop

name: Breadth-First Search (Queue)
description: Level-order traversal computing shortest unweighted path between vertices.
commonWeaknessPatterns: Forgetting to mark node visited upon enqueue (causing infinite cycle)
Incorrect level size snapshotting

name: Depth-First Search (Recursion/Stack)
description: Deep branch exploration for connectivity, cycle detection, and topological paths.
commonWeaknessPatterns: Call stack overflow on deep recursion
Missing backtrack unmark state in permutations

name: Topological Sort (Kahn's / DAG)
description: Linear ordering of directed acyclic vertices according to dependency in-degrees.
commonWeaknessPatterns: Not checking remaining in-degrees to detect cycles
Mutating in-degree map improperly

name: Dynamic Programming (1D & 2D Memo)
description: Decomposing problems into overlapping subproblems with state caching to avoid exponential recomputation.
commonWeaknessPatterns: Missing base cases
State transition equation index offset
Inefficient memory allocations
